deaths.death_reason: Dimensionally invalid Nusselt correlation (RHS units m^-1.5 s^-1.5, not dimensionless) AND regime mismatch (20-100 kHz in 2-10 mm channels places the geometry in the incompressible-oscillation regime where streaming is confined to thin boundary layers — bulk convective enhancement cannot follow).
deaths.classification_source: kill_surface:equations (final_objection block was bare 'KILLED' — recorded attacker-output defect)
deaths.attacker_basis: At 20–100 kHz in air λ ≈ 3.4–17 mm, and in typical dielectric liquids λ is roughly an order of magnitude larger; channel gaps of 2–10 mm place the geometry in the incompressible-oscillation regime where streaming-induced mixing is confined to thin boundary layers, so bulk convective enhancement predicted by the stated 0.5-power correlation does not materialize.
